description: A musician plays piano alone on a dark stage, side view with a single spotlight.

spec.subject: A lone adult musician, slim build, in a black formal shirt and dark trousers, seated at a glossy black grand piano; short dark hair, no visible accessories.
spec.setting: Dark theater stage at night, empty beyond the performance area. Foreground is the piano bench and the near edge of the grand piano; midground is the pianist and instrument; background falls off into blackness with no visible set dressing.
spec.action: Playing the piano with both hands, body angled toward the keys, head slightly bowed.
spec.camera_angle: Profile side view at eye level, subject slightly left of center, piano extending across the frame
spec.lighting: Single hard white spotlight from high front-left of camera, creating a bright pool on the pianist and piano lid while the rest of the stage remains unlit; high contrast, minimal spill, no visible haze.
spec.style: Digital cinema capture with clean detail and subtle grain, deep blacks, restrained contrast, neutral color grade with cool shadows and warm skin tones; stage-performance look with a single-pool spotlight composition.
